chunks: Do they wait for anything but the Hour, that it may come upon them suddenly? Its signs have already appeared. How then will they be warned when it has come upon them?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the sudden arrival of the Hour and its signs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of the Hour by highlighting that its major signs (ashrat) have already appeared, rendering the sudden arrival of death or judgment inescapable. It serves as a stern warning to the heedless that the period for deliberate preparation has concluded, as the 'reminder' (dhikra) will no longer be effective once the moment of reckoning strikes unexpectedly.
